parameters.jsCode: const rows=items.flatMap(i=>{const v=i.json;if(Array.isArray(v))return v;if(Array.isArray(v.items))return v.items;return [v];});const seen=new Set(),trends=[],commits=[];for(const row of rows){const title=row.title||row.name||row.commit?.message?.split('\\n')[0];const url=row.link||row.html_url||row.commit?.url||'';const date=row.isoDate||row.pubDate||row.published_at||row.commit?.author?.date||'';if(!title||seen.has(title))continue;seen.add(title);const record={title:String(title).slice(0,240),url,date};if(row.commit||row.html_url?.includes('github.com'))commits.push(record);else trends.push(record);}trends.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date).localeCompare(String(a.date)));commits.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date).localeCompare(String(a.date)));const top=trends.slice(0,20);const suggestedWork=['Review the three most relevant trends against current customer problems.','Turn one trend into a small experiment with an owner and a measurable outcome.','Convert the latest project commit into the next test, documentation task, or release note.','Check security, privacy, licensing, and Egyptian regulatory impact before shipping AI, messaging, loyalty, or IoT changes.'];return [{json:{generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),project:'xzenoss/team-saas',trendCount:top.length,trends:top,recentCommits:commits.slice(0,10),suggestedWork,digest:['TEAM SAAS DAILY BRIEF','','Top trends:',...top.slice(0,10).map((t,i)=>String(i+1)+'. '+t.title+' '+t.url),'','Recent project activity:',...commits.slice(0,5).map(c=>'- '+c.title),'','Suggested next actions:',...suggestedWork.map((s,i)=>String(i+1)+'. '+s)].join('\\n')}}];
